sql.propToolProductUtilityState.getAllForCom: select pus.id, pus.product_id, pus.utility_state_id, pus.funding_cap, pus.target_production_factor, pus.archived, pus.active, u.utility_company, s.state, us.company_state_id, p.product_name from props.product_utility_state pus inner join props.product p on p.id = pus.product_id inner join props.utility_state us on us.id = pus.utility_state_id inner join props.utility u on u.id = us.utility_id inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = us.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where pus.archived is not true and u.company_id = :companyId
sql.propToolProductUtilityState.getOne: select pus.*, u.utility_company, us.company_state_id, s.state, p.product_name from props.product_utility_state pus inner join props.product p on p.id = pus.product_id inner join props.utility_state us on us.id = pus.utility_state_id inner join props.utility u on u.id = us.utility_id inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = us.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where pus.id = :id
sql.propToolProductUtilityState.insert: insert into props.product_utility_state(product_id, utility_state_id, funding_cap, target_production_factor, active) values (:productId, :utilityStateId, :fundingCap, :targetProductionFactor, :active)
sql.propToolProductUtilityState.update: update props.product_utility_state set product_id = :productId, active = :active, utility_state_id = :utilityStateId, funding_cap = :fundingCap, target_production_factor = :targetProductionFactor where id = :id
sql.propToolProductUtilityState.delete: update props.product_utility_state set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
